plans.idea: Centered poster stack that keeps the original's structure: logo on top, then the headline and flavour copy, then a row of three bottles (hero plus the two secondary bottles in an adjacent box of matching height), and the Build Your Pack pill centered at the bottom.

Two-column split: on the left, one large bottle with the two smaller bottles grouped right under it as the product family; on the right, the logo, the copy stack and the CTA pill sharing one left edge so the eye reads brand, then message, then action.

Product-first layout: a full-width row of three bottles across the top third, the headline and flavour copy across the middle, and a bottom row that holds the logo on the left and the Build Your Pack pill on the right.
